content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Ebooks nigeria

The restriction of payment platforms like PayPal and Stripe in countries such as Nigeria significantly limits the ability of digital creators to monetize their products. A PayPal account suspension can hold funds for up to 180 days without the possibility of appeal, putting creators at financial risk. The lack of access to these mainstream platforms creates a need for a robust alternative that allows creators to maintain control over their sales and earnings without the fear of arbitrary suspension or restrictions.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Sovereign commerce infrastructure operates on a foundation that allows creators to sell ebooks without relying on traditional payment processors. By utilizing tools like Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto processing, creators can establish a fully functional online store. This architecture ensures that creators have full ownership of their data and processes, avoiding the pitfalls of third-party dependency. The integration of these tools creates a seamless experience for both the seller and the buyer, enabling instant product delivery upon payment confirmation.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in countries where conventional payment solutions are unavailable or severely restricted. It empowers individuals from regions like Nigeria, Kenya, and Pakistan to sell ebooks and other digital products without the barriers imposed by platforms like PayPal and Stripe. By providing a sovereign solution, COREMERCH enables creators to take charge of their digital commerce, ensuring that they can operate independently without worrying about the limitations of foreign payment processors.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure allows creators to operate independently without third-party dependencies.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of sovereign commerce infrastructure include hosting services like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, backend processing through Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, and order management using platforms like Supabase. Coupled with payment processing via NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees, these elements work together to provide a comprehensive solution for selling ebooks. Each component has been chosen to ensure that the creator retains ownership and control over their digital store, eliminating the risks associated with third-party platforms.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling ebooks without PayPal or Stripe, first, set up a GitHub or Cloudflare Pages account for hosting your store. Next, integrate Google Apps Script for backend logic to manage transactions. Choose NOWPayments for crypto payment processing to ensure low fees and instant confirmation. Utilize Supabase for order management, allowing you to track sales efficiently. Finally, load your ebook products, test the setup, and launch your store to start reaching customers.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
